node.statement: Global definition and C^1 regularity of the operations. By 1.3-1.4, U bold-dot V and U^dagger lie in S_delta for every U,V in calU, so mu(U,V)=u_delta(U bold-dot V) and sigma(U)=u_delta(U^dagger) are defined on all of calU x calU and calU and take values in calU. By lem-stage1-polar-retraction, u_delta is C^1 on S_delta; bilinearity of bold-dot and conjugate-linearity of dagger from def-epsilon-cstar-algebra make the two input maps C^1 (as real maps) in finite dimension. Their compositions mu and sigma are therefore C^1.
